newsitem.title: INDIA: India Chidambaram's party delays news conference.
newsitem.headline: India Chidambaram's party delays news conference.

text.p: Former finance minister P. Chidambaram's regional party on Tuesday delayed a news conference to announce its decision on whether or not to join India's new government.
Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) officials in the southern city of Madras said the party's leader, G.K. Moopanar, was holding a meeting with Chidambaram and other senior party officials.
The news conference, initially set for 5 p.m. (1130 GMT), was expected to be held on Tuesday evening, but no time had been set, they said.
